newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp plans statement amid merger rumours.
newsitem.headline: Krupp plans statement amid merger rumours.

text.p: German steel and engineering group Fried. Krupp AG Krupp-Hoesch said on Monday it planned to make a statement to comment on market speculation concerning a possible merger with rival Thyssen AG.
"We will not comment on these rumours now," Krupp spokesman Juergen Claassen told Reuters. "We will issue a press release shortly."

A spokesman for Thyssen also declined immediate comment, but said the company was preparing to make a statement to address market rumours that Thyssen and Krupp could merge their entire operations or some of their activities.
